title: upgrade attention kernels to FlashAttentionV2 + fused rope/rotary + KV-batching scheduling
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: Reduce latency and memory overhead for long-context autoregressive workloads by upgrading attention kernels to FlashAttentionV2 and integrating fused rotary/rope operators plus KV-batching-aware scheduling. This PR replaces the existing attention codepath with a FlashAttentionV2-backed implementation where applicable, introduces a fused QKV+rotary/rope operator to remove extra memcopies and kernel launches, and implements a KV-cache prefetch + batching-friendly read path and scheduler heuristic to increase batching density for repeating prefix requests. Key changes: 1) Add FlashAttentionV2 CUDA kernels with ABI-compatible entrypoints and fallbacks to the previous kernel for unsupported configs. 2) Implement fused rotary/rope ops (single kernel) and fused QKV projection to reduce memory traffic. 3) Extend cache_manager with batched KV reads, prefetch hints, and a lightweight eviction-aware read path. 4) Add scheduler policy that groups requests by compatible KV layouts and sequence-length affinity to improve continuous batching utilization. 5) Perf harness updates and new regression tests (unit + perf). Benchmarks: On our perf lab (A100/80GB pools and T4 clusters) measured against main: Llama-13B-like load with mixed seq lengths (256/1024/2048) shows 1.75-1.9x throughput improvement for long-context (2048) workloads and 12-22% p99 latency reduction for mixed workloads while lowering GPU memory usage by ~8-12% in common scenarios. Rollout plan: staged canary (5% -> 20% -> 100%) across Dedicated and Hosted with automatic rollback triggers tied to perf/regression alerts and eval harness metrics (ENG-1245). Backwards compatibility: no public API changes; model weight formats unchanged; automatic fallback retained. Tests and validation: unit tests added for fused ops and KV read semantics; perf regressions added to the harness. Checklist: [x] Unit tests [x] Perf benchmarks [x] Docs update [x] Feature flag gated rollout [x] Telemetry and metrics added
